text: Five copper rods and a crystal sail on a cord, for porches and doorways. It spends no Pulse and has no job; it is there to look and sound nice.

pages.title: Hanging it
text: Place it under almost anything: a ceiling, a beam, a fence rail, a chain or a leaf canopy. Place it against the side of a block and it hangs from a bracket on that wall instead.
You can walk straight through it: it has no collision, but brushing through knocks a rod.
It rings on its own, now and then on a still day, more in the rain and a lot in a storm. Under a roof it is quieter. Knock it to set all five rods going.
Break what it hangs from and it pops off.
Redstone does nothing to it. It is not a Pulse light, and not a Wind Harp.
